name: slrr_garage
title: Garage
tagline: Take the car apart and build it back, part by part
description: A hands-on garage for West Coast USA. Drive into one of three garages onto a working lift, click parts off the car and back on, tune, paint and repair, order parts for delivery or buy them over the counter at six shops in town. Nothing reloads while you work.
author: Connor Moyle
